notes: Launch manifest for the accepted Docket v0.1 project (identity-md-launches/launch-197-build-docket-v0-1-smallest), adapted for the evm_project launch kind. Application contract: src/Docket.sol:Docket, deployed unchanged from the accepted release. Docket is a permissionless board whose text lives only in transaction logs (IdeaCreated, CommentPosted, Upvoted). It has a nonpayable constructor with no arguments, does not read msg.sender in its constructor, and has no owner, admin, pauser, fee recipient, upgrade path, ETH acceptance, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. There are no privileged roles anywhere in the project, so no argument uses $owner, $token or $contract:* and Docket never references the token. No initialization calls are needed or made. Build configuration is the accepted one: solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, evm_version cancun, bytecode_hash none. Token entry: src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken, a dependency-free fixed-supply ERC-20 with the constants name Docket, symbol DOCKET and 18 decimals; totalSupply is the compile-time constant 10^27 minor units minted once to msg.sender (the factory) in its no-argument constructor. It has no mint, burn, owner, pause, blocklist, fee, hook, proxy, receive or fallback function. The original brief asked for a contract-only release with no token or pool; the evm_project kind cannot admit that (the schema requires a token object and the protected project floor deploys IMD_TOKEN_CREATION_CODE and checks a positive supply held by the factory), so the token exists only as the protocol's reward artifact per ADAPTATION.md and Docket's behaviour is unchanged. The pool entry concerns the launch token only: it pairs the launch token against native ETH (zero address) with fee 3000, tickSpacing 60 and the reference sqrtPriceX96 of 2^96 (price 1:1); the effective opening price comes from the pinned policy's initialMarketCapWei where that policy defines it, and there is no hook. Constructor dependency order is trivial: LaunchToken then Docket, neither depends on the other. Audit finding 45d7c9e53ac8db3d9ee2abe9b15f5778df42a6684060c9ea182d88c6da86aa6c (the supplied manifest set token to null and could not validate): reproduced against the tree as it arrived (jq .token printed null; the draft schema rejected it). Fixed by this manifest, which names the LaunchToken the previous step added and validates against the canonical LaunchManifest schema; test/LaunchToken.t.sol already mirrors the protected token and project floors (factory holds the whole supply across Docket's constructor, admin and mint selectors revert, runtime bounded with no escape opcodes). Local checks: forge build --offline clean; forge test --offline 68 passed, 0 failed. Admission, deployment, address/transaction/block recording, explorer verification with the standard-JSON input, and publication are performed by the network's deployer after review; this manifest authorizes none of them and names no wallet.
